title: Depuration
body:
The centralized depuration system consists of a few large plants connected to domestic and industrial users by a sewage network.
The core depuration process of the plants is biological, with the use of activated sludge: each one differs in size, potential and because of the presence of specific treatment sections.
Gida Spa, the Municipality of Prato, to a different extent, the other municipalities concerned and those companies which use water in their production cycle originating wastewater,  participate in the centralized purification system, represented by a special purpose company (called Consorzio Progetto Acqua Spa).
